verdict.stance: Neutral / HSBC-Affiliated Saudi Corporate & Vision 2030 Lender (A-/A2)
verdict.summary: Saudi Awwal Bank (31% HSBC-owned, post-SABB/Alawwal merger) is Saudi Arabia's third-largest corporate bank with SAR 454.5bn assets, SAR 8.45bn FY25 net profit, and 9M26 operating income of SAR 11.12bn (+1.2% YoY). Robust CET1 (~14.5%) and HSBC technical governance anchor A-/A2 ratings against rapid Vision 2030 corporate loan growth (+15.2% YoY).

positives: Strong corporate banking franchise backed by 31% strategic HSBC shareholding and governance.
Healthy capitalization (CET1 ~14.5%, CAR ~19.2%) and resilient FY25 net profit of SAR 8.45bn.
9M26 NSCI rose +2.8% YoY to SAR 8.89bn (Q326 +6.5% YoY) despite tighter system liquidity.
negatives: Rapid loan growth (+15.2% in FY25 to SAR 298.6bn) outpaces low-cost CASA deposit growth across KSA.
Higher funding costs from time deposits and wholesale sukuk/AT1 issuance compress sector NIMs.
Concentrated exposure to Saudi giga-project contractors and commercial real estate.
